title: MetaX
tagline: An Nft media streaming platform and market place for live streaming contents and creating digital assets
description: This is an app that let you stream content and mint it as nft or let you upload off chain assets from your system into the market place and put it for sale, if you are not a member you can do this but will not earn because you are not an authorize content creator, you can purchase the content creator pack and get rewarded with tokens as you create content, also tokens are distributed automatically to all content creators monthly and if you acquire a decent amount of the distribution you can join our DAO and this hack will expand beyond the timespace of this hackathon
how_its_made: I deployed my own contracts for the custom nft marketplace and nft port for the video nft, I also used unlock for the membership to become a content creator i used livepeer for streaming, ipfs/filecoin with nft.storage for uploading assets, i used covalent to view the data of the address used to mint the nft
